# MarketFit

> MarketFit sizes the local market for your startup or expansion — first location, new location, vertical or horizontal move — and gives you an honest read: how big the pie is, how crowded the table is, and whether your slice pencils.

MarketFit is a free web tool at https://marketfit.nesohq.com/. It runs in the browser with no account.
It is for founders and owners planning a first location, a new location or an expansion.

## Questions MarketFit answers

- **How do I size the market for a local business?** Build it bottom-up: households or businesses in the trade area, multiplied by how often they buy, multiplied by what they spend.
- **Why do lenders prefer bottom-up market sizing?** Because every assumption is visible and can be argued with.
- **How many competitors is too many?** There is no fixed number — what matters is spend per competitor in the trade area.
- **Is there room for another business like mine in my town?** The honest test is whether the remaining demand after existing operators still supports your fixed costs at a realistic share.

## Use it

- [Open MarketFit](https://marketfit.nesohq.com/)
